sentences.content: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
sentences.english: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone ?
sentences.chinese: 当你和别人交谈时会感到紧张吗？

sentences.content: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
sentences.english: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger ?
sentences.chinese: 你是否觉得和陌生人交谈很困难？

sentences.content: If you have such worries, it is time for you to learn some more conversation skills.
sentences.english: If you have such worries , it is time for you to learn some more conversation skills
sentences.chinese: 如果你有这样的担忧，是时候学习一些更多的对话技巧了。

sentences.content: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
sentences.english: Here are some tips for making better conversations
sentences.chinese: 以下是一些让对话更顺畅的建议。

sentences.content: Listen carefully and show interest in others.
sentences.english: Listen carefully and show interest in others
sentences.chinese: 认真倾听并表现出对他人的兴趣。

sentences.content: One of the most important things is to listen to the person you speak to.
sentences.english: One of the most important things is to listen to the person you speak to
sentences.chinese: 最重要的事情之一就是倾听与你交谈的人。

sentences.content: If you are a good listener, you will find some good points to ask questions about.
sentences.english: If you are a good listener , you will find some good points to ask questions about
sentences.chinese: 如果你善于倾听，就会发现一些值得提问的要点。

sentences.content: For example, if someone tells you their hobby and you can ask questions about it, they will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
sentences.english: For example , if someone tells you their hobby and you can ask questions about it , they will surely be happy to continue the conversation
sentences.chinese: 例如，如果有人告诉你他们的爱好，而你能就此提问，他们一定会乐意继续交谈。

wordDetails.definition: tell（第三人称单数）: 告诉

sentences.content: Choose the right topic.
sentences.english: Choose the right topic
sentences.chinese: 选择正确的主题。

sentences.content: Some of the best topics might be the weather, sports, music, films, food, or travel.
sentences.english: Some of the best topics might be the weather , sports , music , films , food , or travel
sentences.chinese: 一些最佳话题可能包括天气、体育、音乐、电影、美食或旅行。

sentences.content: However, it is impolite to ask someone’s age, weight, or other personal information.
sentences.english: However , it is impolite to ask someone's age , weight , or other personal information
sentences.chinese: 然而，询问他人的年龄、体重或其他个人信息是不礼貌的。

sentences.content: Also, if you don’t agree with others, don’t argue with them.
sentences.english: Also , if you don't agree with others , don't argue with them
sentences.chinese: 此外，如果你不同意他人的观点，也不要与他们争论。

sentences.content: Just move on to another topic.
sentences.english: Just move on to another topic
sentences.chinese: 换个话题吧。

sentences.content: Be honest and sincere.
sentences.english: Be honest and sincere
sentences.chinese: 诚实而真挚。

sentences.content: If you have no idea of a subject, just say “I don’t know much about it.”
sentences.english: If you have no idea of a subject , just say " I don't know much about it ."
sentences.chinese: 如果你对某个话题一无所知，直接说“我对这方面不太了解”即可。

sentences.content: If you want to make the other person happy, mention his or her strong points.
sentences.english: If you want to make the other person happy , mention his or her strong points
sentences.chinese: 若想让对方开心，就多提他或她的优点。

sentences.content: But don’t just pretend to be nice, because people can find out you are not telling the truth.
sentences.english: But don't just pretend to be nice , because people can find out you are not telling the truth
sentences.chinese: 但不要只是假装友善，因为人们会发现你言不由衷。

sentences.content: Pay attention to your body language.
sentences.english: Pay attention to your body language
sentences.chinese: 注意你的肢体语言。

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 注意

sentences.content: Sometimes it is just as important as your words.
sentences.english: Sometimes it is just as important as your words
sentences.chinese: 有时它和你的话语一样重要。

sentences.content: Don’t be nervous.
sentences.english: Don't be nervous
sentences.chinese: 别紧张。

sentences.content: Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself—you have a lot to offer.
sentences.english: Stand up straight , smile , and be yourself — you have a lot to offer
sentences.chinese: 挺直腰板，保持微笑，做真实的自己——你有很多优点值得展现。

sentences.content: If you really work at it, you will find having conversations much easier
sentences.english: If you really work at it , you will find having conversations much easier
sentences.chinese: 如果你真的努力练习，就会发现与人交谈变得容易得多
